title: Robopon 2 - Ring Version
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 8399 (addresses converted to GBA bus addresses)

widgets.text:
Cody and his team of Robopon (robot monsters), up to 4 in battle
HP, level, energy; each Robopon has a type

Robopon gain levels and can be powered up with parts
Moves come from software (installed programs)

Use software that matches the opponent's weakness
Batteries in the field restore energy
Island towns and routes; Robopon battle sites

Software (moves), batteries, parts, money
Software slots give moves; parts boost stats; batteries refill energy in the field
Many Robopon to collect; Cross and Ring versions differ

Beat the story's rival tamers and bosses island by island
Robopon owned are counted; levels per slot shown on Status
